question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Odious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Repugnant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"odious"** means extremely unpleasant or repulsive. (अत्यंत अप्रिय या घृणास्पद)
 
 
• **Example: **He found the task of cleaning the dirty, odious room to be extremely distasteful.
 
 
 
• **"Repugnant" **refers to something that is extremely distasteful; unacceptable. (घृणित)
 
 
• **Example: **The idea of cheating in exams is repugnant to most students.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'odious' **is **'repugnant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Repugnant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pleasant **(सुखद): Giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment.
 
 
• **Example:** We spent a pleasant evening at the park.
 
 
 
• **Acceptable **(स्वीकार्य): Able to be agreed on; suitable.
 
 
• **Example: **The proposal was acceptable to all the members of the committee.
 
 
 
• **Beautiful** (सुंदर): Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.
 
 
• **Example:** The sunset over the mountains was a beautiful sight.
